title: Fixes from your notes, and the Padiano
thisBuild: Pads redraw straight away after you change a sound (note #6).
Hold now holds short sounds too: a held one-shot loops until you let go (note #4). In the doctor, When held picks loop it, hold the tail, or play once.
Hold has a Last setting below 1: only your newest note holds, and the next one takes over (note #1).
Pad menus open when you lift after holding still. A slide never opens a menu, and a pad you play never scrolls the page.
Pages and sheets fade and slide instead of snapping (note #5).
The piano is now the Padiano. It opens as one row of small squares; ⚙ sets how many notes (7 to 36), the size, Squares or Keys, and In key only.
In key only hides out-of-key notes. It's in the scale bar and the ☰ menu.
☰ menu, Playing: Empty pads record (tap to start, tap to stop, or hold to record) and the beat glow behind everything (off, soft, full).
watch: Turn Hold on, play a short drum hit, and lift: it should keep going until you press it again.
Try In key only with a minor scale on the Padiano.
Swap a pad's sound from the picker and check that the pad's name changes.
limits: Glide, the side dock, Lock, the new effects and XY pads are coming in the next builds.
Creature cards, the Ring, jams and duels stay on the site.
